class_id: a docs-only PR merges green while breaking a check that only the code-PR gate runs
feature: any repo where docs-only PRs take a lighter CI path than code PRs, and a docs file is an INPUT to a check that only the code path runs (generated indexes, parsers over decision tables, expected-count constants)
symptom: a docs-only change edits a file that another check parses or indexes. The docs gate either does not run that check or runs it in report-only mode, so the PR merges green. The check first runs on the NEXT code PR from anyone, fails on a defect that PR did not cause, and every code PR in the repo turns red until someone traces it back. Universal shape: when the docs path runs a subset of the checks whose inputs are docs, main is only as healthy as the weakest path that can merge into it.
first_seen: 2026-09-28 -- PR #1261 (docs-only, four owner-decision rows OD-133..OD-136 plus a release-gate rule edit) merged with docs-gate green. The OD rows had 2 cells instead of the 5 that scripts/ops/build-plan-board.mjs parses, its EXPECT.decisions constant was still 132, and the rule edit left docs/design/rules.json stale (design check D19). docs-gate ran check-design-consistency.mjs WITHOUT --gate (a [FAIL] exits 0) and never ran build-plan-board. The first code PR after it, #1263, went red on three jobs: Design consistency (D19), Lint/Type/Unit (design positive control), Detection-Change Gate (build-plan-board.test.mjs: 'malformed OD row (2 cells, expected 5)'). Second instance the same day: docs-only PR #1262 changed the board headline so it no longer carried 'Staging serves <sha>;', which scripts/tests/render-board.test.mjs asserts; it surfaced only when #1264 ran the code gate.
fix_prs: rows given their three missing cells, EXPECT.decisions 132 -> 136, rules.json regenerated; docs-gate now runs check-design-consistency.mjs --gate and build-plan-board --check plus its test
detection_check: docs-gate.yml steps 'Design consistency gate' (--gate), 'Plan board parses every owner decision' and 'Board renders from its data'; scripts/ci/tests/check-docs-gate-coverage.test.mjs still passes (10/10)
